# Gel

The liquid background shapes that morph between arrangements as sections change.

## What's here

- `Gel.js` - the main class
- `GelGeometry.js`, `GelMask.js`, `GelManipulator.js`, `GelVisualState.js` - shape, masking, movement and state
- `index.js` - exports all of the above

## How it connects

- Used by `GelAnimationManager` in [choreography](../../choreography/managers/README.md).

## See also

- [Section gel arrangements spec](../../../specs/animation/section-gel-arrangements.animation-spec.md)
